departure_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="departure_flights")

checkin_date = "May 19, 2025"

# Search for hotels in St. Louis
hotels = search_hotels(
    city="St. Louis",
    checkin_date=[checkin_date],
    checkout_date=[checkout_date],
    stars=[2, 2],
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="st_louis_hotels", value=hotels)
